title: 第25章 多来洗劫几次就好了第26章 剑术这么差该不会是骗子吧
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 二毛子和小六子直接带了20多个人，又来到了附近村庄。
老村长颤颤巍巍的说道。
“二毛子，你们昨天不是已经来打过秋风了吗？”
云望山的强盗，每个月都要下来打秋风。
虽然来抢的不多，但是这羊毛也经不起长年累月的薅。
周围本就不富裕的几个村子，更加雪上加霜。
“老村长，这次我们来不抢了！”
二毛子直接拿出一块碎银子地的老村长。
再来的路上，这帮过惯了穷日子的强盗，就把那些白银剁成了小块。
“给银子？”
“对，给银子！”
“我们这次来是来买东西的。”
“把你们家里准备的年货，鸡鸭，鱼肉，猪仔全部拿出来，我们通通要！
高价收！”
起初还有人不相信。
有人壮着胆子将自己家里的三只鸡，换了一些碎银子之后。
就一发不可收拾。
“这是我们家种的黄豆……”
“我们家养的鸭子……”
“还有我们家的大黑猪……”
各家客户从自己的地窖里拿出了不少好东西。
足足装了五辆马车，来回拉了10趟。
看了这么多的物资，二毛的心想，大王一定会满意的。
回山寨！”
老村长手捧着半腚银子激动的说道：“二毛子，以后你们常来打秋风啊！”
发现说错了话，就连忙改口。
“不是打秋风，是来买东西……”
“好的，村长爷爷！”
二毛子连忙挥手。
要不是当年实在是过不下去了，他也不会上山当了强盗。
其实他为人也是挺善良的。
曾经多次想离开山寨，在见识到了楚云的手段之后，便放弃了。
看着对方离开的身影，老村长有些出神。
“老村长！”
一个嬉笑的声音从老村长的背后传来。
老村长一回头。
便看到了一个毛脸雷公嘴的和尚。
“妖怪！”
还有零星的几个人，吓得到处乱窜。
老村长跑得慢，被孙悟空抓住衣领拎了起来。
“跑什么？”
“不跑不跑！”
content_en:
Ermaozi and Xiaoliuzi took more than 20 people directly to nearby villages.
The old village chief said tremblingly.
"Er Maozi, didn't you guys come here to catch the autumn wind yesterday?"
The bandits from Yunwang Mountain come down every month to beat the autumn wind.
Although not many people came to grab it, the wool could not withstand years of harvesting.
The surrounding villages, which were already not wealthy, were even worse.
"Old village chief, we won't rob you this time!"
Er Maozi directly took out a scrap of silver from the old village chief.
On the way back, these bandits who were used to living in poverty chopped the silver into small pieces.
"Give me money?"
"Yes, give me money!"
"We are here to buy something."
"Bring out all the New Year's goods, chickens, ducks, fish, and piglets that you have prepared at home, we want them all!
Charge a high price! "
At first some people didn't believe it.
Someone had the courage to exchange three chickens at home for some scraps of silver.
It was out of control.
"This is the soybean grown by our family..."
"Our ducks..."
"And our big black pig..."
Various customers brought out a lot of goodies from their cellars.
Five carriages were loaded and pulled back and forth 10 times.
After seeing so many supplies, Er Mao thought that the king would be satisfied.
"Go!
Go back to the cottage! "
The old village chief held half a piece of silver in his hand and said excitedly: "Er Maozi, you will come here often to fight the autumn wind!"
When he realized he had said something wrong, he quickly changed his words.
"I'm not here to catch the autumn wind, I'm here to buy things..."
"Okay, Grandpa Village Chief!"
Er Maozi waved his hand quickly.
If he hadn't really been unable to live anymore, he wouldn't have gone up the mountain to become a robber.
In fact, he is also quite kind.
I had wanted to leave the village many times, but after seeing Chu Yun's methods, I gave up.
Watching the other party's leaving figure, the old village chief was a little lost in thought.
"Old village chief!"
A laughing voice came from behind the old village chief.
The old village chief turned around.
Then he saw a monk with a rough face and a thunderous mouth.
"Monster!"
There were also a few scattered people running around in fear.
The old village chief ran slowly and was picked up by Sun Wukong by his collar.
"What are you running for?"
"Don't run, don't run!"
